newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 5c to 553c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 5c to 553c/kg.

text.p: The Australian eastern wool market indicator rose a further five cents to 553 cents a kg clean at sales in Sydney and Melbourne on Wednesday, Wool International (WI) said.
In the merino fleece market, 19 micron was slightly dearer, 20m was was slightly cheaper, 21m 0.5 percent dearer and 22m 2.5 percent dearer.
Merino skirtings were up to 1.0 percent dearer.
In crossbreds, 27/28m were 1.5 percent dearer, 29/30m were 1.0 percent dearer and 31m was 0.5 percent dearer.
